test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A rod of length (8)/(9) meters breaks into two pieces. If one piece is (1)/(3) meters long, find the length (in m) of the other piece.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rod = 8/9 meters

Length of one piece = 1/3 meters

**Formula used:**

Length of the second piece = Total length - Length of the first piece

**Calculation:**

Length of the second piece = (8/9) - (1/3)

⇒ Length of the second piece = (8/9) - (3/9)

⇒ Length of the second piece = (8 - 3)/9

⇒ Length of the second piece = 5/9 meters

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
